theme_central: "He frowned": direct correction of the Prophet for having favored a Meccan notable over a blind man sincerely seeking knowledge — a man's true worth is his sincerity, not his rank.
sources_note: Opening narrative (Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum) extremely well documented and undisputed; rest of the structure reconstructed from classical, widely taught landmarks.

branches.title: He frowned
branches.resume: The Prophet turns away from a sincere blind man to attend to a notable; immediate divine correction.

children.t: Divine correction: favoring a notable over a sincere blind man

branches.title: A Reminder on honored sheets
branches.resume: This is a Reminder for whoever wishes to remember, recorded on honored, purified sheets.

children.t: The Qur'an, a Reminder on honored, purified sheets

branches.title: Man's ingratitude
branches.resume: Cursed be man, how ungrateful he is! Created from a drop, guided, then called back to death and resurrection.

children.t: Man's ingratitude despite his creation made easy by Allah

branches.title: Let man look at his food
branches.resume: Water poured down, earth split open, grain, vines, olives, palm trees, gardens — for man and his livestock.

children.t: The cycle of food as a sign of divine care

branches.title: The Day of the Deafening Cry
branches.resume: Man will flee from his own brother, mother, father; radiant or darkened faces according to deeds.

children.t: Everyone fleeing from their relatives, radiant or darkened faces that Day
